Indicators/context: CBC, cytokine panels, saliva/blood markers, symptoms and exposure context
Gap: Assay-specific units, specimen and timepoint must remain attached
Interpretation boundary: CBC alone cannot establish overall immune competence

Indicators/context: DXA, bone turnover, exercise load, nutrition and mission phase
Collected evidence: NASA standards, bone brief, bed-rest metadata
Gap: Individual flight DXA and exercise telemetry not obtained
Interpretation boundary: Exercise completion is a countermeasure record, not a BMD measurement

Indicators/context: ECG, BP, pulse, oxygenation, fitness, symptoms, ultrasound when indicated
Collected evidence: OSD-575 cardiac cytokines; BIDMC waveforms; Bio-Monitor
Current coverage: Lab tables and Earth waveform benchmarks collected
Gap: No live NASA crew feed or clinical event ground truth
Interpretation boundary: A cytokine panel does not diagnose a clot or predict an event

Indicators/context: Private self-report, workload, sleep, cognition and team context
Collected evidence: Standard Measures; behavioral and workload briefs
Interpretation boundary: Wearables cannot directly measure mood, conflict or psychiatric diagnosis

Indicators/context: Actigraphy/light, sleep diary, duty schedule, cognition
Current coverage: Protocol, EDF+ annotation and condition dictionary collected; PSG transfer incomplete
Gap: Earth PSG differs from astronaut actigraphy and has medication context
Interpretation boundary: Sleep opportunity, estimated sleep and sleep stage are different quantities

Indicators/context: Instrument dose rates, location/shielding, personal dosimetry, solar events
Collected evidence: RadLab historical ISS slice; DONKI; NOAA GOES
Current coverage: Environmental readings and event snapshots downloaded
Interpretation boundary: Instrument absorbed dose, dose equivalent and career effective dose are not interchangeable

Indicators/context: CO2, pressure, temperature, humidity, module and ventilation context
Current coverage: API documented; slice collection status in Assets
Gap: Experiment location and units require review before exposure assignment
Interpretation boundary: An experiment sensor is not automatically the crewmember's exposure

Indicators/context: Ocular imaging, ultrasound, visual complaints, mission duration
Collected evidence: SANS technical brief; ESA bed-rest metadata
Current coverage: Evidence and partner catalog metadata collected
Gap: No usable crew imaging series collected
Interpretation boundary: Do not infer SANS from pulse, sleep or consumer camera images

Indicators/context: Intake, hydration, urine, chemistry, exercise and medications
Collected evidence: OSD-575 CMP; OSD-656 urine inflammation; nutrition brief
Current coverage: Lab tables and reference material collected
Gap: No food inventory or validated intake log
Interpretation boundary: Urine inflammatory proteins do not directly measure hydration or stone risk

Indicators/context: Body site, capsule surface, sampling controls and assay
Current coverage: File inventories and ISA metadata collected
Interpretation boundary: Capsule, skin and stool samples belong to different subjects/sites

Indicators/context: Duty schedule, EVA, maintenance, consumables, communication state
Collected evidence: EIMO ConOps; medical operations technical brief
Gap: No mission-specific CHOC, operational schedule or procedure pack
Interpretation boundary: Job title alone is insufficient context; time-bounded duties matter

Indicators/context: Consent, care relationship, release purpose, access log and delegated authority
Collected evidence: NASA standards; role brief; FHIR references
Gap: Exact mission permissions require an approved policy
